content:
Hi everyone,

I'm trying to update the DDI codebook metadata xml file of a dataset file using the Dataverse API. The dataset file in question is a .sav file that has been ingested on our Dataverse instance.

I'm using the following curl command:

curl -v \
  -H "X-Dataverse-key:$API_TOKEN" \
  -X PUT \
  "https://dataverse-test.bsc.es/api/edit/3286" \
  --upload-file ddi_corrected.xml

The request completes successfully, returning HTTP 200 OK and the following response:

{"status":"OK","data":{"message":"Nothing to update"}}

See attached .txt file for the full curl output:

dataverse_api_error.txt

The XML file (ddi_corrected.xml) is approximately 608 KB and contains the updated DDI metadata xml.

Does anyone know why Dataverse might return "Nothing to update" despite the PUT request being successful?

Is there a particular API endpoint or XML structure I should be using to update the metadata of an existing Dataset file through the Dataverse API?

Just to give some extra context: the reason why I want to do this is because I noticed that for some categorical variables encoded as numbers in tabular files ingested via Dataverse there are some extra, unnecessary sumStat lines. I thought it would be possible to just update the resulting xml file that has been generated during the ingestion. See below an excerpt from the metadata file in question, with the lines I want to remove commented out:

<var ID="v3242" name="DEVICE" intrvl="discrete">
<location fileid="f3287"/>
<labl level="variable">DEVICE</labl>
<!--
<sumStat type="mode">.</sumStat>
<sumStat type="max">3.0</sumStat>
<sumStat type="min">1.0</sumStat>
<sumStat type="mean">2.44438202247191</sumStat>
<sumStat type="stdev">0.88186201780734</sumStat>
<sumStat type="medn">3.0</sumStat>
<sumStat type="invd">0.0</sumStat>
<sumStat type="vald">1780.0</sumStat>
-->
<catgry>
<catValu>3</catValu>
<labl level="category">Mobile</labl>
<catStat type="freq">1263</catStat>
</catgry>
<catgry>
<catValu>1</catValu>
<labl level="category">Desktop</labl>
<catStat type="freq">472</catStat>
</catgry>
<catgry>
<catValu>2</catValu>
<labl level="category">Tablet</labl>
<catStat type="freq">45</catStat>
</catgry>
<varFormat type="numeric"/>
<notes subject="Universal Numeric Fingerprint" level="variable" type="VDC:UNF">UNF:6:gM8qpKE4+3iy+u9WtjXY8A==</notes>
</var>

Is this a known bug in Dataverse?
Thanks in advance!

  • https://github.com/IQSS/dataverse/blob/v6.12.1/src/main/java/edu/harvard/iq/dataverse/api/EditDDI.java#L151
  • https://github.com/IQSS/dataverse/blob/v6.12.1/src/main/java/edu/harvard/iq/dataverse/api/EditDDI.java#L164
